answer: Farming becomes a wharf bet on surviving 95 epochs of grading, and every spiral settlement recomputes the prism schedule, so a hostile operator who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 17 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 95 epochs rather than arriving at once. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
